note: Where a ragdoll corpse's skin reaches, per bone, so the corpse is seated ON the floor (physics-death-impl.js). A body row's capsules cannot be as thick as plate armour, a cape or a skirt (the role table caps a radius at a fraction of its bone), so without this the skin of warden, veteran, knight and butcher ends 0.15 to 0.26 m below the floor the capsules rest on. Per model: `bones` (bone names) and `vertices`, the skin vertices that can be a corpse's lowest point (per bone, the furthest one in each of 26 directions). A vertex is a list of influences [bone index, weight, x, y, z]: the vertex in that bone's space at the bind pose (metres, rounded to the millimetre); skinned at runtime as the renderer skins it. tools/physics-floor-support.mjs writes this file. A model with no entry here is not lifted.
